paragraphs.text: Ognis is a viashino warrior of the Riveteers family in New Capenna .

Ognis is an engineer and boiler for the Riveteers. She is a big, muscle-bound viashino with red-rimmed eyes and bright white, pointed teeth. She wears a Riveteer coal cap and carries a large wrench, and can breathe green fire.

Even dragons need assistants. While the big lizards count the money, someone has to make sure their operations run smoothly and the Halo keeps flowing. Ognis is Ziatora 's first captain, a Viashino in Ziatora's image - if smaller, to satisfy the old demon dragon's vanity. A front-line tough, Ognis is the overseer of all Halo trade in the Caldaia and the master strategist behind the Riveteers ' low city–raiding operations.

Though her front-line status might make her seem low-ranking among the family elite, for the Riveteers, staying on the front lines is a mark of strength and solidarity. Scrapping and fighting are hard work — those cut out for the life often find it a short one. Ognis, though she was one of the first Viashino at Ziatora's side and remains one of the few to be granted Ziatora's coveted green flame, still stands shoulder to shoulder with her comrades, breaking heads and counting coins.
